name: Memoria
source: The youngest, most energetic, and innocent girl. Due to her youth, she ends up playing a crucial role in this story. Inside her hat lives her pet, "Chappy," and she frequently ends up causing commotions alongside Miriam. Thankfully, in terms of magic, she is reliable as she is capable of using summoning spells.
